scope: national presentation-month totals only; no practice or patient records

resources.sql:
SELECT YEAR_MONTH,BNF_CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE,CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE_BNF_DESCR,BNF_CODE,BNF_DESCRIPTION,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows,SUM(ITEMS) AS items,SUM(TOTAL_QUANTITY) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(QUANTITY*ITEMS) AS quantity_times_items,SUM(NIC) AS nic,SUM(ACTUAL_COST) AS actual_cost,
    COUNTIF(NIC IS NULL) AS nic_null_rows,COUNTIF(ACTUAL_COST IS NULL) AS actual_cost_null_rows
    FROM `EPD_202309` WHERE CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE_BNF_DESCR IN ('Sodium valproate','Valproic acid')
    GROUP BY YEAR_MONTH,BNF_CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE,CHEMICAL_SUBSTANCE_BNF_DESCR,BNF_CODE,BNF_DESCRIPTION
